notes.title: 50th Anniversary - The Blue Flame - New World Land Speed Record
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31003665/ee0d4f5910c60cac173f1881f01d3daa00855fa0.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=nOFVUNoT5wE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


October 23, 1970, Bonneville, Salt Flats, Utah. Rocket-powered vehicle The Blue Flame driven by Gary Gabelich set a new World Land Speed Record which lasted for more than a decade and became the first car in the history to achieve 1000km/h.
